mechanism: Propafenone is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4; vitamin D may indirectly affect cardiac electrophysiology through calcium-phosphate metabolism and potentially CYP3A4 modulation.
action: Monitor cardiac function and propafenone levels; ensure vitamin D dosing is appropriate to maintain normal serum calcium and electrolytes, as hypercalcemia can potentiate propafenone's arrhythmogenic effects.
